correctness.rationale: The weight-zero equations at (v,v) and (1,1) eliminate the scalar components; (1,v) gives T²=0, and all remaining equations hold because products in V vanish and 2=0. Thus u is free, P²(a+v)=aT(u), and P³=0. The image–kernel flag and quotient isomorphism count T of rank r by H_(n,r). For fixed T, choose matched coordinates for its image and a complement to its kernel; commuting automorphisms act by the same invertible map on the matched coordinates and by independent translations between the relevant blocks. This is transitive on each of the four vector strata and does not change stratum. Their sizes are 1, q^r−1, q^(n−r)−q^r and q^n−q^(n−r); multiplying by H yields the exact class sizes. Only two types are present at r=0 and three at r=n/2>0, giving the stated parity totals. Index three is exactly the last type and is realized for n>=2. Fresh full ambient-map and group enumeration (branches/7576d6ef-8a28-4ebc-8ef2-37e82e822169/independent_rb_check.py and independent_rb_gf4_check.py) tested 512, 65536 and 262144 maps for (q,n)=(2,2),(2,3),(4,2). It found respectively 16, 176 and 256 operators, sorted orbit sizes (1,3,3,3,6), (1,7,21,21,42,84), (1,15,15,45,180), and index-three counts 6,84,180. This bounded verification includes a nonprime field and does not replace the proof. The frozen checker was inspected, not executed.
